namespace = hunt

# Jewish Communities: kosher options added to vanilla events.
# GENERATED by scripts/kehillah_build_kosher_overrides.py from the
# installed game; edit the script, not this file. Each event is a verbatim
# vanilla copy plus id_override_priority and one option marked
# "Jewish Communities", so the rest of the vanilla file stays untouched.

# Vanilla file-local trigger, copied from events/activities/hunt_activity/hunt_events.txt
scripted_trigger can_eat_boar_trigger = {
	NOT = { culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_vegetarianism } }
	NAND = {
		scope:activity.var:animal_type = flag:boar
		faith = {
			OR = {
				religion = religion:islam_religion
				religion = religion:judaism_religion
			}
		}
	}
}
